stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.sentenceEn: A small adjustment makes the crooked picture frame level.

items.sentenceEn: Each taxpayer contributes money that supports shared public services.
items.sentenceZh: 每位纳税人缴纳的钱都会支持共享的公共服务。

items.sentenceEn: The eager apprentices lean forward to watch the glassmaker begin.
items.sentenceZh: 满怀期待的学徒们探身观看玻璃匠开工。

items.sentenceEn: The principal welcomes students at the school gate each morning.
items.sentenceZh: 校长每天早晨在校门口迎接学生。
items.scene: At the entrance of a contemporary Chinese school, the adult principal warmly greets arriving students while teachers and families recognize her leadership role through respectful interaction, with no signs or written labels.
items.altText: A school principal welcoming students at the gate.

items.sentenceEn: The detailed drawing reveals every vein and tiny hair on the leaf.
items.sentenceZh: 这幅细致的图画呈现了叶片的每条叶脉和细小绒毛。

items.altText: A detailed leaf drawing showing veins and tiny surface hairs.

items.sentenceEn: Protecting sea turtles is her motivation for studying marine science.
items.sentenceZh: 保护海龟是她学习海洋科学的动力。
items.scene: An adult student works intently with marine samples and a microscope while a connected vision of a healthy sea turtle swimming free above restored coral shows the motivating goal behind her effort, without text.
items.altText: Sea turtle protection providing motivation for marine science study.

items.sentenceEn: Their assignment is to build a bridge from a limited set of sticks.
items.sentenceZh: 他们的任务是用有限数量的木棍搭一座桥。
items.scene: A teacher presents a simple bridge model and one small tray of craft sticks, while a team of adult learners begins building their own bridge at a classroom table, clearly showing an assigned task without written instructions.
items.altText: Learners completing an assignment to build a bridge from sticks.

items.sentenceEn: The height restriction prevents the tall truck from entering the tunnel.
items.sentenceZh: 限高规定阻止高大的卡车进入隧道。
items.scene: At a tunnel entrance, a rigid overhead height bar physically stops one tall truck while lower cars pass safely underneath in another lane, making the restriction and its effect clear without numbers or signs.
items.altText: A height restriction stopping a tall truck at a tunnel.

items.sentenceEn: The samples are tested under controlled conditions in the laboratory.
items.sentenceZh: 这些样本在实验室的受控条件下接受检测。
items.scene: Inside a modern laboratory, adult scientists wearing appropriate coats, gloves, and eye protection use microscopes, pipettes, sealed sample tubes, and controlled equipment at orderly benches, with no readable screens or labels.
items.altText: Scientists testing samples in a controlled laboratory.

items.sentenceZh: 工坊里摆满了供工匠雕刻木制玩具的工作台。

items.altText: Artisans carving wooden toys at benches in a workshop.

items.sentenceEn: The two artists paint the same vase differently.
items.sentenceZh: 两位艺术家用不同的方式画同一个花瓶。

items.altText: Two artists painting the same vase differently.

items.sentenceEn: The mechanic raises the auto to inspect its wheels and brakes.
items.sentenceZh: 修理工升起汽车以检查车轮和刹车。

items.altText: A mechanic inspecting an auto raised on a garage lift.

items.sentenceEn: They share a romantic evening beside the lantern-lit lake.
items.sentenceZh: 他们在灯笼映照的湖边共度浪漫夜晚。

items.altText: A couple sharing a romantic evening beside a lantern-lit lake.

items.sentenceEn: The cotton is picked from soft white bolls and spun into thread.
items.sentenceZh: 棉花从柔软的白色棉铃中采下并纺成线。

items.altText: Cotton being picked from white bolls and spun into thread.

items.sentenceEn: The shop owner decides to sue the contractor for the serious damage.
items.sentenceZh: 店主决定就严重损失起诉承包商。

items.sentenceEn: Toasted sesame and scallions give the noodles a rich flavor.
items.sentenceZh: 烤芝麻和葱花赋予面条浓郁的风味。

items.altText: Sesame and scallions giving noodles a rich flavor.

items.sentenceEn: The old pavilion can overlook the river valley from the high cliff.
items.sentenceZh: 古老的亭子可以从高崖俯瞰河谷。

items.altText: A high pavilion that can overlook a winding river valley.

items.sentenceEn: A fallen leaf can float on the pond instead of sinking.
items.sentenceZh: 落叶可以漂浮在池塘水面而不下沉。

items.sentenceEn: The old bridge must undergo major repairs before it reopens.
